verdict.rationale: Navan is an in-platform travel booking tool. It offers global travel inventory (navan-docs-10) and self-serve changes (navan-docs-11), and flights and hotels can be booked through Navan Edge (navan-docs-45). Policy shows up at booking time for hotels, where every search displays a 'price to beat' under the employee's policy limit (navan-docs-12), and the product advertises policy and approval workflows (navan-docs-25). Missing for 10: explicit evidence of policy enforcement or out-of-policy blocking/approval at booking time for flights, detail on how pre-trip approval workflows work, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
